integrity: The general theorem has a direct all-graph cycle proof. Finite computations corroborate the face criterion but do not prove it in arbitrary size. No independent validation or publication-priority certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the canonical diagonal-augmented bipartite double cover and the specified layer swap. Its complete-graph wedge ranks are known classical matroid invariants, not new counts. An equivalent unindexed graph-covering or signed-graphic formulation remains possible.
title: A cone-graph model for the layer-swap fixed forest complex of a bipartite double cover
